sources.quote: or a change of coating or surface treatment.
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.
Aurelia Automobili - Supplier Quality Manual, revision 3, section 7 "Changes".

findings.why: BK-330 belongs to PRG-Z, an Aurelia program. The meeting relied on revision 3, which only required notification for a coating change. Revision 4 replaced it. Under revision 4 a coating change (ZNNI to zinc flake) needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment, and notification at least 90 days before implementation. Nothing in force covers this change.
